name: Is it possible to replace bathroom flooring without removing the toilet?

mainEntity.name: Is it possible to replace bathroom flooring without removing the toilet?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's technically possible to replace some bathroom flooring without removing the toilet by cutting around its base, it's generally not recommended for a professional, durable, and water-tight installation. Removing the toilet allows for a continuous, seamless floor installation underneath, which is crucial for preventing water seepage into the subfloor. It also makes for a cleaner, more professional finish. A qualified contractor will almost always recommend temporarily removing the toilet to ensure the highest quality outcome and proper moisture protection.
acceptedAnswer.description: While possible, it's not recommended to replace bathroom flooring without removing the toilet. Removing it ensures a seamless, water-tight, and professional finish.
